#!/bin/bash

START=$1
END=$2

if [[ $START == $END ]]; then
  echo 0
  exit 0
fi

if [[ $START =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$ ]] && [[ $END =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$ ]]; then
  if [[ $START > $END ]]; then
    START=$END
    END=$START
  fi

  holidays=$(cat /app/holidays.txt | grep -v ^# | sort -u)

  count=0
  for day in $(seq -w $START $END); do
    if [[ $day =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$ ]]; then
      if [[ $day != $END ]]; then
        if [[ $day != $(date -d $day +%u) -eq 6 || $day != $(date -d $day +%u) -eq 7 ]]; then
          count=$((count + 1))
        fi
      fi
    fi
  done

  echo $count
  exit 0
else
  exit 2
fi
